Page 70 Cont.
May 26 Alberta Mrs. Ryers - 46 - of Bay C. - fearful gall-stones .... Drs seem to have very little hopes.
28 Irene Baker - 23 - May 30 - in Kiefer's - spinal maningitis Barbara Hoyt - 11 - feeble mind.
Page 71 Mrs. Jadwiga Kosch - 67 - goitre and Heart-trouble - at times serious
May 28 Mrs. Anna Boos - 62 - Very serious case of throat and chest trouble - voice and speech gone ... Enrolled perpetually in S.M.A.
Patricia Meagher - 25 - in Ypsilanti - mental break.
29 phone - Mrs. Helen Berg - 34 - of Bay City - cancer - husband and baby of 7 mo.
Runelda Brinkman - 28 - lutheran - very peculiar numbness - someway almost like paralyzed - This has been going on about 4 years - last two years notwithstanding quite a number of doctors. . Enrolled in Ser. Masses To-day
Mary Mac Neil - 44 - had two big tuomers removed and Drs say another must come out ... very delicate operation - They advise a famous Dr. in Boston - - and one less famous in Ann Arbor. Enrolled.
Page 72 May 31 John Vander Voort - 57 - presbiterian - brain tumor - hopeless ac- cording to Drs .... Harper Hosp. - Enrolled To-night.
Mr. Crawford - 84 - heart - away from the sacraments 60 yrs. Mar- ried out of Church - wife promised his mother on dying bed that she would see to getting a priest for him. She has been doing her part as best she can, but so far he refused - Pentecost & Easter D. Thanks to God.
Kenneth Kahn - 26 - a soldier now away in Jamaica W. Indies - has wife and two children - praying he may be sent nearer home.
Sabina Van Karle - 36 - and friend same age - mysterious misunder- standing ....
John Felmer - 54 - T. B. "Quidk" has 8 in family.
Levi Buckley - 41 - methodist became indiferent to Family - to Divorce
